capabilities: Display and edit events on a calendar inside the vault
Create events from note frontmatter and daily note event lists
Read ICS calendars from remote or local files
Sync two-way with CalDAV servers, Google Calendar, and Google Tasks
Sync tasks with the Obsidian Tasks and TaskNote plugins
extras: Main documentation lives on an external Documentation site. The bundled main.js is 3.35 MB because Obsidian guidelines require bundling external libraries; the README offers build instructions for a ~1.4 MB build. Development is funded by a community subsidy (~25 USD/month) to cover AI tools.
intentEvidence: This is the remastered edition of original Full Calender plugin by Davis Haupt, with the core additions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar for keeping schedules and events alongside notes and tasks, or for syncing with external calendars.

relations.evidence: This is the remastered edition of original Full Calender plugin by Davis Haupt
integrates the FullCalendar library into your Obsidian Vault
Tasks Plugin: Sync with the Obsidian Tasks plugin
TaskNote Integration: Sync with TaskNote Plugin

summary: Calendar view plugin that stores and displays events from notes, daily notes, ICS files, CalDAV, and Google Calendar inside the vault.
